verifiers_session_lifetime.author: hallerite
implementation_source_verified: _agent_finished returns true only when not _failed and stop_condition is None or agent_completed.
Normally finished or between-segment agents retain harness session while task.finalize and artifact/collect commands run.
Same-box grading runs task.score/on_score before closing session and tool/interception stack; harness metrics run after close.
Isolated grading closes after collection, captures metrics before stopping execution, then finalizes services and grades in its own runtime.
Stopped-mid-turn/timeout path closes the harness before grading, intended to prevent a still-acting agent from changing the graded environment.
New _close_harness catches/logs session or tool/interception teardown exceptions; _metrics_deadline caps metrics at min(30s,scoring/10).
Second commit f144485 adjusts finalize deadline by close/metrics interlude time in isolated grading.
